title: Memglide warm study: 80 completed assignments, user-requested stop

design.memory_scope: Same still-active Memglide session across fresh native Codex processes, not cross-new/ended/expired Memglide-session persistence.

stop.reason: User requested stop after 80 completed assignments; one already-started 81st original interrupted and retained

matched_first_72_post_hoc.selection_rule: First eight complete three-arm sequences in frozen order, after user requested stop; not prespecified confirmatory subset.

B_vs_A.inference: Post-hoc descriptive partial first-repeat comparison; no confidence interval or causal/billed-cost saving conclusion.

C_vs_B.inference: Post-hoc descriptive partial first-repeat comparison; no confidence interval or causal/billed-cost saving conclusion.

C_vs_A.inference: Post-hoc descriptive partial first-repeat comparison; no confidence interval or causal/billed-cost saving conclusion.

cost_component_diagnosis.scope: Matched72, native-reported cache-write point estimate only; arithmetic decomposition, not causal attribution.

offline_redundancy_diagnostic.scope: Offline descriptive diagnosis only; exact path+hash overlap with supplied source. Byte counts are not tokens. Never a treatment, grading, tuning or promotion signal.

audit.correction: Initial auditor treated interrupted raw terminal-looking events as whole-attempt usage; finalized auditor honors execution_outcome_unknown. Original estimator/report already kept interrupted cost unknown. No native run regraded, retried or replaced.

promotion.reason: User stopped partial first-repeat study; no full216 assignment/two-repeat validation. Point subset cannot authorize promotion.

limits: All dollar values are API-list-price equivalents, not actual charges or subscription savings.
Native-reported cache-write zero may reflect upstream omission; sensitivity scenarios are not confidence intervals.
First72 subset is post-hoc; one repeat, only8small repositories,5TypeScript/3Python sequences.
All80completed assignments passed;81st was user-interrupted with unknown outcome/cost.
Unrun rows are not failed model attempts; interrupted row is retained, not treated as evidence of coding inability.
Instrumented full timing includes treatment audit work and parent overhead, not pure product latency.
Local CPU lower bound and sampled native-tree RSS do not isolate Memglide overhead or provider resources; shared pages and short-lived processes limit accuracy.
Read/command counts are lexical native-event proxies, not actual filesystem reads or model inference counts.
Provider/OS caches, routing and response stochasticity uncontrolled; identical B/Ccold prompts still differ.
Current source/hash agreement proves observed freshness and delivered-byte completeness, not semantic completeness or claim truth.
Zero configured MCPservers; completed80observed MCPcalls0, interrupted completenessunknown; no model-efficiency-through-MCP conclusion.
Engineering tests and earlier native cohorts remain separate; no pooling to hide failures.
